id./param/scenario/cs/b_070_cs_040.pack|cs_: "Hey, Princey. Why are you sleeping? Didn't you come to investigate the star?
"It's rare to see such a huge star from right below it, so I'm commemorating it. Amazing. You should all try.
"By the way, what are these ruins? Odd, all alone in the middle of this wasteland.
"Who knows? They've been here since my grandfather's grandfather's grandfather's time, but I don't know details.
"They may have had an important role when built. I feel ancient romance.
"Hm... Indeed there seems to be writing on the star. Let's begin the investigation."
